title: Earlier as-of days show no Adjustments value because history is not backfilled
refs: SV-9282 (WIP spec v24 per Chris Ward 2026-08-19; S11-R8; S11-R9 - Adjustments captured in its own snapshot column,no history backfill,missing value read as zero)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A nightly snapshot exists for a day before the Adjustments column was introduced..
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report.
2. Set the "as of" date to a day before the Adjustments column existed.
3. Read the Adjustments values on the historical rows.
expected:
1. Rows for that earlier day show an Adjustments value of $0.00 (a missing snapshot value is read as zero).
2. Historical Adjustments values are NOT recomputed from today's data.
3. Earned and Remaining on those historical rows are unchanged - their captured values do not move.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and story SV-9282, and the Work In Progress report specification version 24 (S11-R8, S11-R9), as pinned by Chris Ward on 19 August 2026, recorded in his answers in this file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bilalmuzamil-sketch/Manual-test-Cases/claude/slack-session-0sxnd9/build/report-suite/chris-answers-2026-08-19/WIP-CHRIS-RULINGS-2026-08-19.md.
